user.title: Set up VomeSync
user.description:
VomeSync uses **keypair authentication** with a locally stored signing key.

Use **Generate new user key** to create a fresh signing key, or untick to paste an existing one after submit. After setup, back up the signing key from **More → Backup signing key**.

⚠️ Anyone with the UID can view switch state and activity in Public mode.

subscribe_switch.title: Subscribe to a switch
subscribe_switch.description:
Enter a switch UID to subscribe to. The name will be fetched automatically, and you can rename the entity afterwards in Home Assistant.

You can find public UIDs at sync.vome.io.
